content: {"episode_id":"ep-05007","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes. Because the ordered service is supported by these documented diagnoses and indications, we request review and reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 820.46."}
